fields.summary_ko.0: INTC plunged 28.6% the day after Q3 2026 earnings announcement, with Q4 revenue guidance of $15–16B downward revised from expected $16.5B.
fields.summary_ko.1: Data center revenue surged 80% year-over-year to $7.3B, but PC chip revenue declined 9% quarter-over-quarter and is expected to decline more than 20% in Q4.
fields.summary_ko.2: Fab 28 factory incident caused approximately $300M revenue decline and packaging material shortage limited 10-nanometer server shipments.
